title: Settings
description: Settings are stored on this computer. Download options apply when a task is created or resumed.

general.saveLocationHint: Saved as soon as a folder is chosen; affects new tasks only.

resumeOnStart.label: Resume tasks on startup
resumeOnStart.hint: Continue the tasks that were downloading or queued when the app last quit.

notifications.label: Notify when downloads finish
notifications.hint: Show a system notification when a file is saved.

minimizeToTray.label: Keep downloading after closing the window
minimizeToTray.hint: Minimize to the system tray; quit from the tray menu.

keepHistory.label: Keep parse history
keepHistory.hint: Remember successfully parsed links on the new task page so they can be parsed again; stored on this computer only. When off, nothing new is recorded; existing entries can be cleared from the new task page.

concurrency.label: Simultaneous downloads
concurrency.hint: Up to 4 tasks download in parallel.

speedLimit.label: Global speed limit (KiB/s)
speedLimit.hint: 0 means unlimited; the limit is split evenly across download slots.

taskSpeedLimit.label: Default per-task speed limit (KiB/s)
taskSpeedLimit.hint: 0 means unlimited; can be adjusted per task in task details.

timeout.label: Connection timeout (seconds)
timeout.hint: Retry when a connection or media read stalls for too long.

retries.label: Download retries
retries.hint: Retry after a file or fragment fails; once exhausted you can retry manually.

batchLimit.label: Batch limit
batchLimit.hint: The most items one click on "Download selected" queues, taken from the top of the list. 0 means no limit.

files.namingHint: The task ID prevents files with the same name overwriting each other. Retries reuse the original file name and resume where supported.

organizeByPlatform.label: Subfolder per platform
organizeByPlatform.hint: New tasks are saved to the matching platform folder.

organizeByCollection.label: Subfolder per collection
organizeByCollection.hint: Collections and parts are saved to a folder named after the collection; with the option above also on, the path is platform/collection.

files.mergeHint: Separate video and audio streams are merged automatically. Photo posts keep the original image format.

save.label: Save the cover image with videos
save.hint: Store a cover image with the same name next to the video.

embedVideo.label: Embed the cover in video files
embedVideo.hint: Make the cover the video file's own artwork; some players and File Explorer don't read MP4 cover tracks.

embedAudio.label: Embed the cover in audio-only downloads
embedAudio.hint: Audio files carry the cover, shown by players as album art.

cover.hint: Most platforms serve WebP, which Windows File Explorer thumbnails inconsistently. Photo posts get no extra cover, since the post itself is images. "Download cover" in a task's context menu is always available, regardless of these switches.

subtitles.label: Subtitles
subtitles.languagesPlaceholder: Leave empty to follow the interface language
subtitles.languagesHint: Comma-separated, in order of priority; enter all to download every language.

autoGenerated.label: Use auto-generated subtitles
autoGenerated.hint: Fall back to the platform's speech-recognition subtitles when a language has no human-made ones.

normalize.label: Normalize overlapping subtitle cues
normalize.hint: Join YouTube rolling caption fragments so one language does not render twice at once.

subtitles.hint: Only works on platforms that provide subtitle tracks; best supported on YouTube and on Bilibili when signed in. When embedded in MP4, subtitles are converted to mov_text, which some players may not show.

browser.systemDescription: {{browser}}. Parsing first tries to read its sign-in session directly. If reading fails because of system encryption or the browser being in use, it is skipped automatically; public content is not affected.
browser.sessionsHint: For content that requires signing in, sign in once in the app; the sign-in session is stored on this computer and survives restarts.

tools.localHint: Local tools update with the app; downloading and parsing run on this computer.

verboseLogging.label: Verbose logging
verboseLogging.hint: Write each request's status code, duration, waits and the start of abnormal responses to the log; turn on when troubleshooting parse failures. Credentials are redacted, and logs stay on this computer. Takes effect after saving settings.

allowControl.label: Allow the command line and agents
allowControl.hint: Lets the galaxy command line, and agents that use it, parse, download and read tasks through a local channel. Only the current user on this computer can connect; no network port is opened.

commandLine.title: Command line tool
commandLine.hint: Install the galaxy command to parse and download from a terminal or an agent, with the sign-ins kept in this app.
commandLine.installed: Installed: {{path}}. Run galaxy in a new terminal.
commandLine.notOnPath: This directory is not on your PATH yet; add it to your shell profile and open a new terminal.
